sloka: न अराजके जनपदे हृष्टैः परमवाजिभिः ।नराः सम्यान्ति सहसा रथैश्च परिमण्डिताः ॥२-६७-२५॥
transliteration: na arājake janapade hṛṣṭaiḥ paramavājibhiḥ ।narāḥ samyānti sahasā rathaiśca parimaṇḍitāḥ ॥2-67-25॥

translations.english: In a country without a king, welldressed men are no longer enthusiastic to drive on excellent horses and on chariots.
